title: San Francisco Chinatown and North Beach Highlights Walking Tour
includes: Tour is led by an and first-class expert local guide
See Columbus Tower – owned film director and vintner Francis Ford Coppola
Visit Broadway – one of San Francisco’s most charming lively neighbourhoods
See the famous Cable Cars of San Francisco
Visit the stunning 853 foot tall Transamerica building with its iconic shape
Walk under the famous Dragon Gate in Chinatown
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please wear comfortable shoes as this tour involves a fair amount of walking, including over uneven surfaces, cobblestones, hills, inclines, declines and stairs.
Participants should be in good health - consult first with your doctor if you have any medical condition or are not used to regular exercise.
Wheelchairs, motorised scooters or any other device to assist mobility are not recommended, as we cannot guarantee: that all footpaths/sidewalks/curbs will have suitable ramps.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately.
Anybody under the age of 18 years must be accompanied by somebody aged 18 years or older.
Not recommended for travellers with limited mobility
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Buckle up for a whirlwind adventure with our Top 10 San Francisco Highlights Tour! From the legendary Chinatown—bigger and tastier than you can imagine—to the must-see spots that make this city sparkle, we’ve got your San Francisco bucket list covered. Dive into 300 years of history and discover why so many people leave their hearts in this iconic city. Discover the essence of San Francisco with our unique 3-hour walking tour! This immersive experience goes beyond the typical sightseeing, taking you through the city's most iconic highlights and hidden gems.
With our expert local guide, explore vibrant neighbourhoods and enjoy exclusive views of the city's breathtaking skyline. Visit the Golden Gate Fortune Cookie Factory, where you can watch cookies being made. This tour combines San Francisco’s must-see landmarks with authentic local experiences, offering an unforgettable journey through one of the world’s most captivating cities.
